scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/domain/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/functions/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p firebase/tests/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:unit: vitest run packages/domain/src packages/schemas/src apps/functions/src && vitest run --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.build: tsc -p packages/domain/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/schemas/tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p packages/ui/tsconfig.build.json && pnpm build:functions && vite build --config apps/web/vite.config.ts
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
